description: This file defines a generic interface 'DataEnricher' used for enriching data objects of type T. It includes method signatures for checking support for a data type and performing enrichment.

classes.name: DataEnricher
classes.description: A generic interface for classes that can check support for data types and enrich data objects.

methods.name: isDataTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if the data type T is supported for enrichment.

methods.name: enrich
methods.description: Performs enrichment on the provided data object of type T.
